# NeuralNg Radio

IMPORT
import { NeuralRadio, NeuralRadioGroup, type NeuralRadioSelectionChange } from '@neural-ng/core/radio';

RULES
- Use NeuralRadioGroup for every radio set; do not compose unrelated native names manually.
- Prefer [options] with optionLabel and optionValue for data-driven choices.
- Use projected <neural-radio [value]="..."> only for rich option content.
- Do not combine [options] and projected neural-radio children. [options] wins.
- NeuralRadioGroup implements FormValueControl<TValue | null>.
- RadioGroupComponent and RadioComponent are deprecated compatibility aliases; never generate them in new code.
- Bind the model with [(value)] or use [formField], [formControl], or [(ngModel)].
- Programmatic Forms writes update value without emitting selectionChange.
- valueChange is the generated model output. selectionChange is the detailed user-only event.
- selectionChange payload is { value, previousValue, option, source }.
- source is "pointer" or "keyboard".
- Radio selection does not toggle back to null. Use a separate clear action if product UX needs clearing.
- orientation is "vertical" by default and also accepts "horizontal".
- Native radio inputs, shared name, Arrow keys, Home, End, Space, focus, required, disabled, validation, and form submission are preserved.
- readonly is not disabled: the roving tab stop remains focusable, aria-readonly is exposed on the group, and user mutation is blocked.
- touch is emitted when focus leaves the group. focus() targets the roving tab stop and reset() restores null.
- iconClass and optionIcon values may use Neural Icons classes such as "nt-user"; the base "nt" class is added automatically.
- Set unstyled for local headless mode or provideNeuralNg({ unstyled: true }) globally.
- Consumer classes survive unstyled mode.
- Inside neural-field, RadioGroup inherits id, descriptions, required, invalid, disabled, readonly, fluid, and unstyled state.

DATA EXAMPLE
<neural-radio-group
  [options]="plans"
  optionLabel="name"
  optionValue="id"
  optionDisabled="disabled"
  optionIcon="iconClass"
  [(value)]="planId"
  (selectionChange)="planSelected($event)"
/>

FORMS EXAMPLE
<!-- Signal Forms -->
<neural-radio-group [options]="plans" [formField]="form.plan" />

<!-- Reactive Forms -->
<neural-radio-group [options]="plans" [formControl]="planControl" />

<!-- Template-driven Forms -->
<neural-radio-group [options]="plans" name="plan" [(ngModel)]="plan" />

PROJECTED EXAMPLE
<neural-radio-group [(value)]="delivery">
  <neural-radio value="standard" iconClass="nt-truck">
    <strong>Standard delivery</strong>
  </neural-radio>
  <neural-radio value="express">Express delivery</neural-radio>
</neural-radio-group>

CLASS SLOTS
root, option, input, control, selectedControl, disabledOption, label, optionIcon
